best_for: People who want a VPN they can try for free with a monthly data cap, then pay only for the countries they use, or go Pro if they need unlimited data.

points.title: Free has a data cap
points.text: The free plan gives 10 GB a month if you confirm your email address, or 2 GB without one. Unsubscribing from promo emails also drops you to 2 GB. Free users get servers in 10 countries.

points.title: Pro and pay-per-location
points.text: Pro is USD 9 a month or USD 69 a year and opens every location with unlimited data. Build-A-Plan costs USD 1 per location per month, with a USD 3 minimum, and each location adds 10 GB. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Ad and tracker blocking
points.text: R.O.B.E.R.T. blocks ads, trackers and malware domains you choose. On Build-A-Plan it is a USD 1 add-on together with unlimited data.

points.title: Protocols and kill switch
points.text: It connects over WireGuard, OpenVPN, IKEv2 and Stealth modes meant for networks that block VPNs. A firewall stops traffic outside the tunnel, and split tunneling lets you pick which apps use it.

points.title: Open-source desktop app
points.text: The desktop app's code is on GitHub under GPL-2.0. It needs Windows 10 1809 or later (Windows 11 for Arm64) and macOS 14.4 or later. Windscribe also builds a Linux app, which this site does not list.

points.title: Mac lags behind here
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 27 versions and is at 2.25.8; macOS lists only the current release, 2.24.12, so a Mac downgrade needs another source.
